feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 October 2026 5:06am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 01 October 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of Scotland continues to track northwards and fill.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5, increasing 4 or 5 this afternoon, becoming Southerly 5 or 6 this evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain spreads from the west later this evening/overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southerly 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 early afternoon tomorrow, then veering and decreasing West or Northwest 4 or 5 in the evening, and 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming moderate or rough around midday tomorrow, then falling slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Spells of rain, becoming fair overnight into Saturday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
